$comment: Every part of the design system, for people, the docs site and AI agents. scripts/check.mjs fails when this file and the folders disagree.

components.name: Box
components.description: A surface: padding, background, border, radius and shadow, each from the tokens.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Children in a column, with the same gap between each.

components.name: Inline
components.description: Children in a row, with the same gap between each.

components.name: Text
components.description: Body text in one of the editor's sizes, tones and weights.
components.useInstead: Heading for titles, Tag for a status.

components.name: Heading
components.description: A title. `level` sets its place in the page outline; `size` changes only how big it looks.

components.name: Tag
components.description: A short label for a state or a category, such as Draft or Published.

components.name: Button
components.description: Starts an action: save, publish, add, delete.
components.useInstead: A link component for going to another page.

components.name: TextField
components.description: One line of text, with its label, help and error.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Children in equal columns, with the same gap between each.
components.useInstead: Inline for a row of buttons or tags, Table for rows of data.

components.name: Link
components.description: Goes to another page.
components.useInstead: Button for something that happens on this page.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: A button that shows only an icon. Its label is its accessible name and its tooltip.
components.useInstead: Button for the main action of a screen.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: One yes-or-no choice.

components.name: Select
components.description: One choice from a list, with its label, help and error.
components.useInstead: Menu for a list of actions.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short hint shown when a control is hovered or focused.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A window over the page that must be dealt with before going back to it.

components.name: Menu
components.description: A list of actions that opens from a button.
components.example: <Menu trigger={<IconButton label="More actions" icon={Ellipsis} />} actions={actions} onAction={run} />
components.useInstead: Select for choosing a field's value.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Views of the same thing, one shown at a time.

components.name: Table
components.description: Rows of the same kind of thing, with a heading for each column.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: The top of every screen: its title, what it is for, and its main actions.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: What a screen shows where its content will be, before there is any.
components.example: <EmptyState icon={House} title="No listings yet" action={<Button>New listing</Button>} />

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description: Asks before doing something that is hard to undo.
components.example: <ConfirmDialog isOpen={isOpen} onOpenChange={setOpen} title="Delete listing?" confirmLabel="Delete listing" cancelLabel="Cancel" tone="danger" onConfirm={remove}>…</ConfirmDialog>

components.name: TextArea
components.description: Several lines of plain text, with its label, help and error.

components.name: Switch
components.description: A setting that is on or off, and takes effect at once.
components.useInstead: Checkbox for a choice saved later with a form.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Where short messages appear. Put one in the app and call toast() to show a message.
components.useInstead: Dialog for anything that needs an answer.

components.name: AppShell
components.description: The frame around every screen: the sidebar with its navigation, and the main area.
components.example: <AppShell brand={brand} navLabel="Main" skipLabel="Skip to content" nav={nav}>…</AppShell>

components.name: SaveBar
components.description: The bar that stays at the bottom of an editing screen, with the entry's state and its save buttons.

components.name: Form
components.description: Fields that are sent together, in a column.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Says that something is on its way.
components.useInstead: Button isPending for an action under way.

components.name: AuthShell
components.description: The frame around the screens before sign-in: one card in the middle of the page.

components.name: NumberField
components.description: A number, written in the person's own format, with its label, help and error.
components.useInstead: TextField for numbers that are really names, such as a postcode.

components.name: DateField
components.description: A calendar date, typed in the order the person's language writes it.

components.name: Fieldset
components.description: Several fields that belong together, under one name.
components.useInstead: Heading over a Stack to split a long form into sections.
